data: In fiscal 2023 (year ended September 30, 2023), Apple reported net sales of $383.285 billion, gross profit (reported as "gross margin") of $169.148 billion, and operating income of $114.301 billion. That works out to a gross margin of about 44.1% ($169,148 million divided by $383,285 million) and an operating margin of about 29.8% ($114,301 million divided by $383,285 million). Both were slightly lower than in fiscal 2022, when gross margin was about 43.3% on $394.328 billion of sales and operating margin was about 30.3%, so the gross margin actually improved by roughly 0.8 percentage points even as operating margin slipped by about 0.5 points, reflecting higher operating expenses of $54.847 billion versus $51.345 billion.
